attributes.title: 2027 ANNA National Symposium
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ANNA National Symposium for nephrology nurses is held April 18 to 21, 2027, at the Rosen Shingle Creek Hotel in Orlando, Florida. ANNA runs it as a hybrid meeting, so sessions can also be followed by livestream.

The event listing gives April 18 to 21, while the poster call on the same page says April 17 to 21, which may reflect pre-symposium activities. Contact hours, registration fees and hotel rates have not been published yet; ANNA asks attendees to book rooms only through its own reservation link.
